description: This file implements the ChannelMonitor class and related classes for handling modem simulator command channels, including client management, command parsing, and communication over file descriptors.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a client connection with associated file descriptors and methods to send responses.

classes.name: ClientId
classes.description: Unique identifier for clients, with static incrementing ID.

classes.name: ChannelMonitor
classes.description: Manages multiple client connections, command parsing, and communication for the modem simulator.

methods.name: Client::SendCommandResponse
methods.description: Sends a response string to the client over its write file descriptor.

methods.name: Client::SendCommandResponse (vector overload)
methods.description: Sends multiple responses to the client.

methods.name: ChannelMonitor::SetRemoteClient
methods.description: Adds a remote client connection and triggers the monitor loop.

methods.name: ChannelMonitor::AcceptIncomingConnection
methods.description: Accepts a new incoming client connection.

methods.name: ChannelMonitor::ReadCommand
methods.description: Reads and parses commands from a client, dispatching them to the modem.

methods.name: ChannelMonitor::SendUnsolicitedCommand
methods.description: Sends an unsolicited response to the first connected client.

methods.name: ChannelMonitor::SendRemoteCommand
methods.description: Sends a response to a specific remote client identified by ClientId.

methods.name: ChannelMonitor::CloseRemoteConnection
methods.description: Closes a remote client's connection and triggers monitor loop.

methods.name: ChannelMonitor::~ChannelMonitor
methods.description: Destructor that signals the monitor thread to exit and joins it.

methods.name: ChannelMonitor::removeInvalidClients
methods.description: Removes invalid clients from the client list.

methods.name: ChannelMonitor::MonitorLoop
methods.description: Main loop that monitors file descriptors for activity and handles client communication.
